purpose: Test context-support density for fixed h256 while preserving the low-density h256 predictor, query mixture, seeds, targets, held-out blocks, and predictor-level gates.

research_question.primary: At fixed NativeDinoPrefixStudent hidden_dim=256 and fixed 1500-update WIDE+QUERY training, does increasing support from 128 to 256 contexts by adding four disjoint starts per episode materially improve held-out planner-candidate ranking?
research_question.secondary: Does high-density h256 satisfy existing absolute ranking, logged-action MSE non-inferiority, causality, and predictor-only latency boundaries?
research_question.unit_of_analysis: one held-out context x one fresh action-prefix seed block; candidates within a block are repeated measurements
research_question.primary_comparison: high-density h256 step1500 minus read-only low-density h256 step1500 from job 24456882.pbs101
research_question.query_density_claim: forbidden; logged/Gaussian/CEM action-query mixture is unchanged

entry_gate.authorization: The prior capacity effect failed and full replacement was NO-GO; this separate density contrast is authorized.
entry_gate.do_not_reinterpret: Prior metrics authorize the next axis only; they are not the density result.

scope.only_new_treatment: same 32 train episodes, four additional contexts per episode, 128 existing plus 128 appended contexts

parent_protocol.manifest_policy: Preserve existing 128 rows exactly and append only the specified 128 disjoint rows.

baseline.artifact_resolution: Resolve the remote job first, then read the expected local artifact; absent or incomplete low-density h256 data invalidates the contrast.

context_support_density.source_episode_set: exactly the same 32 train episodes as low-density h256

new_rows.ordinal_policy: next available ordinal per existing episode; never renumber old rows
new_rows.start_policy: additional valid starts from the same episodes, excluding every old start index
new_rows.selection_seed_policy: selection_seed = 20260928 + episode_id, applied independently per existing episode

context_support_density.interpretation_boundary: This is support/context density, not query density, query coverage, trajectory diversity, or full-dataset coverage.

frozen_training_bank.heldout_exclusion: No held-out episode, context, observation, action, seed, or evaluation candidate may enter training.

one_step_cem_resample.scoring: frozen teacher terminal objective for the same training context
one_step_cem_resample.precompute: one deterministic CPU-generated bank before first update

frozen_training_bank.target_pairing: Every logged, Gaussian, and CEM-resampled prefix uses the same frozen teacher rollout for detached dense targets.

training.context_pool: exact old 128-row prefix plus appended 128 rows

randomness_and_schedule.manifest_seed_policy: Preserve old rows and append deterministic four-new-row-per-episode selection with selection_seed = 20260928 + episode_id.

context_density_schedule.construction: For each batch, first generate the authoritative low-density 32-row schedule; then use seed 20260929 to select 16 positions without replacement from the 32 positions and replace them with append-support indices sampled with replacement from indices 128..255; the other 16 positions retain their low-density index unchanged.
context_density_schedule.exposure_note: Total batch rows per update remain 32. The treatment fixes 50% newly appended support exposure; the corresponding halving of old-support exposure is the density treatment itself.

randomness_and_schedule.rng_policy: Generate context indices, roles, action proposals, held-out candidates, and timing candidates on CPU with explicit generators before GPU transfer.

ranking.candidate_bank: One shared CPU bank; align high/low h256 by exact (seed, context_index).
ranking.paired_comparison: Same frozen teacher costs, candidate actions, context, and goal.

paired_metrics.aggregation: Median of 16 paired deltas and strict-positive block counts; never subtract arm-level medians.
paired_metrics.primary_effect: context-support density, not capacity and not query density

logged_action_fidelity.statistic: mean across horizons and contexts of dense relative native-latent MSE

causality.metric: maximum output difference after changing only future action tokens

latency.boundary: cached native observation latent plus normalized action prefix through predictor versus five-step frozen teacher

heldout_evaluation.telemetry: During GPU execution append utilization and VRAM every 30 seconds to job log.

density_effect.comparison: high-density h256 step1500 - read-only low-density h256 step1500

logged_fidelity_noninferiority.comparison: high-density h256 / read-only low-density h256 teacher-relative MSE

decision_levels.density_effect: PASS iff all four density_effect thresholds pass; report independently.
decision_levels.full_replacement: GO iff integrity, absolute fidelity, MSE ratio, causality, and latency all pass.
decision_levels.density_supported_replacement: GO iff density_effect PASS and full_replacement GO.
decision_levels.non_equivalence: density_effect PASS does not imply replacement GO; replacement GO does not require density_effect PASS.
decision_levels.query_density_boundary: Never describe the result as query-density improvement because WIDE+QUERY mixture is unchanged.
decision_levels.invalidity: If manifest, baseline artifact, pairing, or integrity is invalid, report NO-GO and do not interpret deltas.

gates.overall_decision: Report context_support_density_effect, full_replacement, and their conjunction separately; do not retune.

claim_boundary.allowed_if_density_effect_pass: Under this frozen predictor-level contract, increasing context-support from 128 to 256 contexts across the same 32 train episodes at fixed h256 WIDE+QUERY 1500-step budget materially improves paired held-out ranking under the stated thresholds.
claim_boundary.allowed_if_full_replacement_go: High-density h256 meets the frozen predictor-level replacement gates against the teacher, including absolute ranking, low-density h256 MSE non-inferiority, causality, and predictor-only latency.
claim_boundary.one_step_cem_qualification: WIDE+QUERY remains a training-only M=64/K=8 one-step CEM elite-resample mixture; no full multi-step CEM claim.
forbidden: parameter or high/low latency ratios as success evidence

execution_constraints.checkpoint_return: No checkpoint retrieval is required as primary result.
